verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's own marketing claims analytics that track resolution quality and customer satisfaction (CSAT-like) via Coach, and says events land in its analytics as tracked outcomes, so the core reporting capability exists. However, the evidence never shows dashboards or names the specific exec metrics, and this comes only from a competitor-comparison page and product taglines. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard documentation, an explicit resolution-rate metric, a handoff/escalation-rate metric, a cost-per-resolution metric, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, dashboards show resolution rate, CSAT, handoff rate, and cost per resolution — the numbers I report to my exec team
